title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06748v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. translated_title: EvoWorld：迈向生成式视频模型中的视野外世界演化
translated_abstract: 生成式视频模型正日益被用作视觉世界模拟器，但它们的主要优势在于渲染逼真的像素，而非推理世界应如何演化。连贯的世界演化所需的不仅仅是视觉保真度：当一个事件发生时，模型必须推断其对世界中实体的影响，然后渲染出由此产生的状态。例如，当一头野兽出现后，模型不仅应该描绘这头野兽，还应该根据实际呈现的场景推断附近的人应该逃跑、躲避还是反击。现有的基于扩散模型的视频模型缺乏维护世界状态并对这类事件条件化后果进行推理的显式机制，常常产生视觉上合理但行为上静态或因果上不一致的输出。为了使这一推理鸿沟具体且可度量，我们提出了一个新问题——视野外因果演化，它要求模型能够对发生在视野之外的事件进行推理，并演化出因果一致的世界状态。
tldr: 提出EvoWorld模型与“视野外因果演化”新问题，使生成式视频模型不仅能渲染逼真画面，还能推理事件对世界实体的影响并生成因果一致的世界演化。
en_tdlr: Proposes EvoWorld and the new problem of Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, enabling generative video models to not only render realistic scenes but also reason about event consequences and evolve causally consistent world states.
